title: Rising Edge Detector
constraints: `pulse` is a registered output: it only changes on rising edges of `clk`.
Each 0 → 1 transition of the sampled `din` produces exactly one cycle of `pulse = 1`.
`rst` is synchronous and clears both `pulse` and the stored previous sample.
hints: Keep one flip-flop holding the value of `din` from the previous clock edge.
A rising edge means: the current sample is 1 and the previous sample was 0, so `pulse` gets `din & ~prev`.
Update `prev` and `pulse` in the same clocked block.

examples.title: reset in between
examples.input: din: 1, then rst = 1 with din = 1, then din = 1 1 0
examples.expected: pulse is 1 again right after reset is released
